title: Coefficients of the binary low polynomial
statement: Let $\ell$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a=(a_0,\ldots,a_{\ell-1})\in\mathbb F_2^\ell$, and let $d$ be a nonnegative integer. The coefficient of $X^d$ in $\sum_{i=0}^{\ell-1}a_iX^i$ is $a_d$ when $d<\ell$, and is $0$ when $d\ge\ell$.
